verdict.rationale: Trello ships built-in AI features, so it is fair to ask whether it can act as an MCP client. The evidence only shows the reverse role: an MCP server that connects Trello to outside AI tools. There is no evidence that Trello can register external MCP servers and use their tools, and Power-Ups and REST APIs are developer building blocks that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
